invariants.rationale: Instant time should be a valid, non-null String representing an operation timestamp.
Bulk insert should operate on a non-null and non-empty list of records.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required for executing Hoodie actions.
Option objects, such as bulkInsertPartitioner, are expected to be non-null even if they are empty.
Option.isPresent() always evaluates to true or false, so this expresses well-formedness of the Option.
